summary: Harden the detail lookup and restyle the UI. Detail now uses POST /api/detail with the key in a JSON body (no URL encoding at all), with the ?key= and unquote()d path forms kept as fallbacks, [404] logging on the server, and a server_version shown in the page footer so a stale process is obvious. UI rewritten in Neumorphism (single surface, paired shadows, no borders) with 5 accent colours and a light/dark toggle.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 5986309. Server route/version + static UI + tests; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: Bug hardening and presentation work only; no model call and no budget/config change.
budget_impact.before: Detail depended on URL-encoded path/query; a stale server process made it 404 with no visible signal; UI used a bordered card style.
budget_impact.after: Detail via POST body with fallbacks, 404 logging and a visible server version; Neumorphism styling with 5 accents and light/dark.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: HTTP 200, correct title, 1339-char abstract, no [404] in stderr

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; bug hardening and UI, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Neumorphism visuals are unverified by the agent (no rendered-page access).
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
Export, notes, Zotero import and Tauri packaging still missing.
